source_text: I’m Detective Bhatt and this is my assistant, Mr. Canmore.

structure.raw_value: MeBaEx#.I’m Detective Bhatt and this is my assistant, Mr. Canmore.
structure.script_literal: "MeBaEx#.I’m Detective Bhatt and this is my assistant, Mr. Canmore."

translation: Jestem detektyw Bhatt, a to mój asystent, pan Canmore.

source_text: I know you have a job to do, but I hope you’ll respect my time.

structure.raw_value: LiBaOp>.I know you have a job to do, but I hope you’ll respect my time.
structure.script_literal: "LiBaOp>.I know you have a job to do, but I hope you’ll respect my time. "

translation: Wiem, że ma pan zadanie do wykonania, ale proszę uszanować mój czas.

source_text: My father’s death has been difficult for me and my family.

structure.raw_value: LiSaOp>.My father’s death has been difficult for me and my family.
structure.script_literal: "LiSaOp>.My father’s death has been difficult for me and my family."

translation: Śmierć mojego ojca była trudna dla mnie i całej rodziny.

source_text: I’m sorry for your loss, Miss Wilkes.

structure.raw_value: MeBaOp.I’m sorry for your loss, Miss Wilkes.
structure.script_literal: "MeBaOp.I’m sorry for your loss, Miss Wilkes. "

translation: Proszę przyjąć moje kondolencje, panno Wilkes.

source_text: I wanted to take a moment to ask you a few questions.

structure.raw_value: MeBaEx.I wanted to take a moment to ask you a few questions.
structure.script_literal: "MeBaEx.I wanted to take a moment to ask you a few questions."

translation: Chciałam zadać pani kilka pytań.

source_text: I will help in any way I can.

structure.raw_value: LiBaOp>.I will help in any way I can.
structure.script_literal: "LiBaOp>.I will help in any way I can."

translation: Pomogę, jak tylko będę mogła.

source_text: We’ve not been able to pull up much on your father apart from some charitable donations and mansion occupancy records.

structure.raw_value: MeBaEx.We’ve not been able to pull up much on your father apart from some charitable donations and mansion occupancy records.
structure.script_literal: "MeBaEx.We’ve not been able to pull up much on your father apart from some charitable donations and mansion occupancy records."

translation: Nie udało nam się znaleźć wielu informacji o pani ojcu poza zapisami o datkach na cele charytatywne i osobach przebywających w rezydencji.

source_text: We just want to rule out any possible explanation for his sudden heart attack.

structure.raw_value: MeBaEx.We just want to rule out any possible explanation for his sudden heart attack.
structure.script_literal: "MeBaEx.We just want to rule out any possible explanation for his sudden heart attack."

translation: Chcemy tylko wykluczyć wszystkie możliwe przyczyny jego nagłego zawału serca.

source_text: Perhaps you can shed some light on what his life was like.

structure.raw_value: MeBaOp.Perhaps you can shed some light on what his life was like.
structure.script_literal: "MeBaOp.Perhaps you can shed some light on what his life was like."

translation: Może pani rzucić nieco światła na to, jak wyglądało jego życie.

source_text: My father was a private man. He believed in giving back and spent much of his time helping the sick and displaced.

structure.raw_value: LiBaEx>.My father was a private man. He believed in giving back and spent much of his time helping the sick and displaced.
structure.script_literal: "LiBaEx>.My father was a private man. He believed in giving back and spent much of his time helping the sick and displaced."

translation: Mój ojciec był skrytym człowiekiem. Wierzył w pomaganie innym i poświęcał wiele czasu chorym oraz osobom zmuszonym do opuszczenia domów.

source_text: My father’s work was important. And now I take on a great burden filling his shoes.

structure.raw_value: LiSaOp>.My father’s work was important. And now I take on a great burden filling his shoes.
structure.script_literal: "LiSaOp>.My father’s work was important. And now I take on a great burden filling his shoes."

translation: Praca mojego ojca była ważna. Teraz spoczywa na mnie wielki ciężar przejęcia jego obowiązków.

source_text: What exactly is this place?

structure.raw_value: McBaDe<.What exactly is this place?
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe<.What exactly is this place?"

translation: Czym właściwie jest to miejsce?

source_text: We offer spiritual healing to those that society has forgotten.

structure.raw_value: LiBaEx>.We offer spiritual healing to those that society has forgotten.
structure.script_literal: "LiBaEx>.We offer spiritual healing to those that society has forgotten."

translation: Oferujemy duchowe uzdrowienie tym, o których społeczeństwo zapomniało.

source_text: Spiritual healing?

structure.raw_value: MeBaDe.Spiritual healing?
structure.script_literal: "MeBaDe.Spiritual healing?"

translation: Duchowe uzdrowienie?

source_text: Servitude to God gives purpose to ones whom the world has left behind.

structure.raw_value: LiFrEx>.Servitude to God gives purpose to ones whom the world has left behind.
structure.script_literal: "LiFrEx>.Servitude to God gives purpose to ones whom the world has left behind."

translation: Służba Bogu nadaje sens życiu tych, których świat porzucił.

source_text: I take it you’re aware of the autopsy report.

structure.raw_value: MeBaOp.I take it you’re aware of the autopsy report.
structure.script_literal: "MeBaOp.I take it you’re aware of the autopsy report."

translation: Zakładam, że zna pani wyniki sekcji zwłok.

source_text: You’ve closed the case?

structure.raw_value: LiBaDe>.You’ve closed the case?
structure.script_literal: "LiBaDe>.You’ve closed the case?"

translation: Zamknęliście sprawę?

source_text: Yes. Your father’s death was determined to be a heart attack.

structure.raw_value: MeBaEx.Yes. Your father’s death was determined to be a heart attack.
structure.script_literal: "MeBaEx.Yes. Your father’s death was determined to be a heart attack."

translation: Tak. Ustalono, że przyczyną śmierci pani ojca był zawał serca.

source_text: We’ve not found anything to warrant further investigation…

structure.raw_value: MeAnOp.We’ve not found anything to warrant further investigation…
structure.script_literal: "MeAnOp.We’ve not found anything to warrant further investigation…"

translation: Nie znaleźliśmy niczego, co uzasadniałoby dalsze śledztwo…

source_text: However, there are records showing that your father may have recently remarried.

structure.raw_value: MeBaEx.However, there are records showing that your father may have recently remarried.
structure.script_literal: "MeBaEx.However, there are records showing that your father may have recently remarried."

translation: Są jednak dokumenty sugerujące, że pani ojciec mógł niedawno ponownie się ożenić.

source_text: Unfortunately, we’ve not been able to identify who this woman could be.

structure.raw_value: MeBaOp.Unfortunately, we’ve not been able to identify who this woman could be.
structure.script_literal: "MeBaOp.Unfortunately, we’ve not been able to identify who this woman could be."

translation: Niestety, nie udało nam się ustalić, kim może być ta kobieta.

source_text: There’s something you should know about my father.

structure.raw_value: LiBaOp>.There’s something you should know about my father.
structure.script_literal: "LiBaOp>.There’s something you should know about my father."

translation: Jest coś, co powinniście wiedzieć o moim ojcu.

source_text: In his final years, his mental state had dissipated.

structure.raw_value: LiBaEx>.In his final years, his mental state had dissipated.
structure.script_literal: "LiBaEx>.In his final years, his mental state had dissipated."

translation: W ostatnich latach życia jego stan psychiczny się pogarszał.

source_text: Our family believes a woman was manipulating him.

structure.raw_value: LiBaDe>.Our family believes a woman was manipulating him.
structure.script_literal: "LiBaDe>.Our family believes a woman was manipulating him."

translation: Nasza rodzina uważa, że pewna kobieta nim manipulowała.

source_text: His relationship was secret, but her presence was known to us.

structure.raw_value: LiBaEx>.His relationship was secret, but her presence was known to us.
structure.script_literal: "LiBaEx>.His relationship was secret, but her presence was known to us."

translation: Ukrywał ten związek, ale wiedzieliśmy o jej obecności w jego życiu.

source_text: My father was distant, and incoherent.

structure.raw_value: LiSaDe>.My father was distant, and incoherent.
structure.script_literal: "LiSaDe>.My father was distant, and incoherent."

translation: Ojciec był nieobecny i mówił bez ładu.

source_text: She wanted something from him, and now that he’s dead, she’s disappeared.

structure.raw_value: LiSaEx>.She wanted something from him, and now that he’s dead, she’s disappeared.
structure.script_literal: "LiSaEx>.She wanted something from him, and now that he’s dead, she’s disappeared."

translation: Czegoś od niego chciała, a teraz, gdy nie żyje, zniknęła.

source_text: You believe this woman could have murdered your father?

structure.raw_value: McShOp<.You believe this woman could have murdered your father?
structure.script_literal: "McShOp<.You believe this woman could have murdered your father?"

translation: Uważa pani, że ta kobieta mogła zamordować pani ojca?

source_text: He called her Madalyn.

structure.raw_value: LiBaEx>.He called her Madalyn.
structure.script_literal: "LiBaEx>.He called her Madalyn."

translation: Nazywał ją Madalyn.

source_text: Madalyn?...

structure.raw_value: MeShOp.Madalyn?...
structure.script_literal: "MeShOp.Madalyn?..."

translation: Madalyn?...

source_text: When did Madalyn get involved with your father? Do you remember?

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.When did Madalyn get involved with your father? Do you remember?
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.When did Madalyn get involved with your father? Do you remember?"

translation: Kiedy Madalyn związała się z pani ojcem? Pamięta pani?

source_text: As far as I can tell, it was earlier this year, perhaps five or six months ago.

structure.raw_value: LiBaEx>.As far as I can tell, it was earlier this year, perhaps five or six months ago.
structure.script_literal: "LiBaEx>.As far as I can tell, it was earlier this year, perhaps five or six months ago."

translation: O ile wiem, stało się to na początku tego roku, jakieś pięć, może sześć miesięcy temu.

source_text: Is there anyone who would have spoken with Madalyn?

structure.raw_value: MeBaOp.Is there anyone who would have spoken with Madalyn?
structure.script_literal: "MeBaOp.Is there anyone who would have spoken with Madalyn?"

translation: Czy ktoś mógł rozmawiać z Madalyn?

source_text: Yes. We have a maid.

structure.raw_value: LiBaEx>.Yes. We have a maid.
structure.script_literal: "LiBaEx>.Yes. We have a maid."

translation: Tak. Mamy pokojówkę.

source_text: She does not live with us. She comes to us from the city.

structure.raw_value: LiBaEx>.She does not live with us. She comes to us from the city.
structure.script_literal: "LiBaEx>.She does not live with us. She comes to us from the city."

translation: Nie mieszka z nami. Przyjeżdża do nas z miasta.

source_text: Where does she live? Can you tell us?

structure.raw_value: McBaOp<.Where does she live? Can you tell us?
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp<.Where does she live? Can you tell us?"

translation: Gdzie mieszka? Może nam pani powiedzieć?

source_text: She lives in the apartments downtown. Her name is Erica Abraham.

structure.raw_value: LiBaEx>.She lives in the apartments downtown. Her name is Erica Abraham.
structure.script_literal: "LiBaEx>.She lives in the apartments downtown. Her name is Erica Abraham."

translation: Mieszka w apartamentowcu w centrum. Nazywa się Erica Abraham.

source_text: I wish I knew more.

structure.raw_value: LiSaOp>.I wish I knew more.
structure.script_literal: "LiSaOp>.I wish I knew more."

translation: Chciałabym wiedzieć więcej.

source_text: Whatever she wanted with him, it’s over now.

structure.raw_value: LiBaEx>.Whatever she wanted with him, it’s over now.
structure.script_literal: "LiBaEx>.Whatever she wanted with him, it’s over now."

translation: Czegokolwiek od niego chciała, teraz to już koniec.

source_text: I only wish I could have said goodbye to him.

structure.raw_value: LiSaOp>.I only wish I could have said goodbye to him.
structure.script_literal: "LiSaOp>.I only wish I could have said goodbye to him."

translation: Chciałabym tylko móc się z nim pożegnać.
